coverage: Targeted multi-pass search across PS3 native recompilation, emulation, PPU/SPU analysis, RSX/shaders, assets, audio and validation. Not a claim to exhaust the internet.

tools.name: ps3recomp
tools.purpose: PPU lifting, SPU discovery/lifting, host runtime and per-title CMake template.
tools.limits: Experimental; generated code and successful compilation do not establish gameplay correctness.

tools.name: RPCS3
tools.purpose: Reference emulator and debugger for comparing the original game against a native attempt.
tools.limits: Requires separate installation and setup; emulation is not a produced native port.

tools.name: RPCS3 source
tools.purpose: Implementation reference for PPU, SPU, system calls and RSX behavior.
tools.limits: Separate codebase and license; source is not copied or automatically merged into this Studio.

tools.name: RSX debugger
tools.purpose: Specialist RPCS3 RSX debugging application.
tools.limits: Check compatibility with current RPCS3 dumps and builds.

tools.name: rsxrecomp
tools.purpose: Standalone RSX vertex/fragment microcode to HLSL translation project.
tools.limits: Experimental alternative to the integrated backend shader path; not a complete renderer.

tools.name: Ghidra
tools.purpose: Disassembly, decompilation and manual investigation of unresolved code.
tools.limits: Decompiler pseudocode needs engineering and validation before it can become a working port.

tools.name: Ps3GhidraScripts
tools.purpose: PS3 binary and ABI analysis scripts for Ghidra.
tools.limits: Upstream notes relocation limitations; use a compatible Ghidra release.

tools.name: GhidraSPU
tools.purpose: SPU processor support for Ghidra.
tools.limits: Work in progress; validate decoded instructions and extension compatibility.

tools.name: ps3ida
tools.purpose: PS3-specific IDA scripts and plugins.
tools.limits: Separate IDA installation required; scripts may need adaptation to modern IDA.

tools.name: Capstone
tools.purpose: PowerPC disassembly support used in analysis workflows.
tools.limits: Disassembly alone does not implement SPU jobs, system calls or graphics.

tools.name: ps3emu
tools.purpose: PPU/SPU rewriting, RSX OpenGL and trace/debugging architecture for Linux.
tools.limits: Upstream labels it work in progress and not practical yet; not an automatic fallback.

tools.name: ChonkyStation3
tools.purpose: Another PS3 emulation implementation for comparison and research.
tools.limits: An emulator, not a native static port generator; compatibility differs.

tools.name: PSL1GHT
tools.purpose: Open PS3 homebrew SDK, API headers and samples for controlled test programs.
tools.limits: Builds software for PS3; it does not directly translate retail games to PC.

tools.name: ps3toolchain
tools.purpose: Open toolchain for compiling PPU/SPU test programs.
tools.limits: Targets PS3 rather than the host PC and is not a generic retail-game porter.

tools.name: PS3 autotests
tools.purpose: Small programs and expected outputs to investigate PS3 behavior.
tools.limits: Individual tests and toolchains require setup; not a commercial-game compatibility guarantee.

tools.name: RenderDoc
tools.purpose: Inspect supported host graphics API captures, draw calls and resources.
tools.limits: Captures the host renderer, not a raw RSX instruction stream; integration compatibility varies.

tools.name: SPIRV-Cross
tools.purpose: Reflect and translate SPIR-V into higher-level shader languages.
tools.limits: Needs SPIR-V input; not a direct RSX decoder.

tools.name: SPIRV-Tools
tools.purpose: Validate, disassemble and optimize generated SPIR-V.
tools.limits: Validation cannot establish visual equivalence to the PS3 shader.

tools.name: glslang
tools.purpose: Shader front end and SPIR-V generation used by graphics workflows.
tools.limits: Install matching CMake packages when required by the selected graphics backend.

tools.name: Radeon GPU Profiler
tools.purpose: Inspect GPU workload timing on supported AMD hardware and drivers.
tools.limits: Hardware/API requirements apply; not a PS3 shader translator.

tools.name: Tracy
tools.purpose: CPU/GPU profiling for instrumented native ports.
tools.limits: Requires instrumentation in the target port.

tools.name: Fossilize
tools.purpose: Serialize and replay Vulkan pipeline objects for specialized shader/cache work.
tools.limits: Useful only with a compatible Vulkan integration; not an RSX replacement.

tools.name: DirectXTex
tools.purpose: DDS conversion, texture processing and mipmap generation.
tools.limits: Original archive decoding, swizzling and reinsertion remain game specific.

tools.name: Compressonator
tools.purpose: Texture compression and quality analysis.
tools.limits: Requires decoded textures and a port that supports the chosen texture format.

tools.name: GtfDdsSharp
tools.purpose: Convert supported GTF and DDS textures.
tools.limits: Upstream describes SDK-derived origins; review provenance and licensing before redistribution. Not bundled.

tools.name: CTXR Converter
tools.purpose: Convert supported CTXR texture variants, including a PS3-specific module.
tools.limits: Format/version specific; not universal PS3 texture extraction.

tools.name: Noesis
tools.purpose: Preview and convert supported asset formats with relevant plugins.
tools.limits: Coverage depends on exact game format and plugin; manual workflow.

tools.name: QuickBMS
tools.purpose: Script-driven extraction of supported game archive formats.
tools.limits: Needs a matching archive script; repacking and asset loading are separate problems.

tools.name: vgmstream
tools.purpose: Decode supported streamed game audio formats for inspection.
tools.limits: Codec/container support is format specific; not a runtime audio-system replacement.

tools.name: FFmpeg
tools.purpose: Decode or inspect supported audio/video formats.
tools.limits: Respect build-specific licensing; PS3 media containers and synchronization may need additional work.

tools.name: Real-ESRGAN
tools.purpose: Upscale decoded images for optional texture experiments.
tools.limits: Must preserve alpha, tiling, normal maps and mip behavior; no automatic in-game texture replacement.

tools.name: flOw port
tools.purpose: A title-specific ps3recomp project to study structure and fixes.
tools.limits: Its patches and support do not automatically apply to another game.

tools.name: You Don't Know Jack port
tools.purpose: A title-specific PS3 recompilation project for studying bring-up work.
tools.limits: Upstream progress claims are not a Studio gameplay verification.

tools.name: inFAMOUS 2 recomp
tools.purpose: Experimental title project for studying unresolved runtime/graphics issues.
tools.limits: Upstream explicitly describes this project as not playable.

tools.name: Drakengard 3 recomp
tools.purpose: Another title-specific ps3recomp project and integration example.
tools.limits: Game-specific patches; not a general compatibility promise.

tools.name: ps3recomp build guide
tools.purpose: Compiler and graphics-backend requirements.
tools.limits: Documentation and implementation can evolve; Studio records the exact checkout revision.

tools.name: ps3recomp porting guide
tools.purpose: Background for diagnosing game-specific bring-up issues.
tools.limits: Some example commands in older prose differ from current tools; Studio adapters follow inspected source.

tools.name: ps3recomp tools reference
tools.purpose: Loader, lifter, imports and function-analysis command reference.
tools.limits: Backend revisions may change command interfaces.

tools.name: Project Pyrrhus (Killzone 2 PC port)
tools.purpose: Killzone 2 (PS3) static recompilation to Windows x64 on ps3recomp v0.18.0 plus its own patch set (port/patches/). Built on your PC from your own disc dump (folder or decrypted ISO), the 1.29 update and your decrypted EBOOT. Direct3D 12 renderer; SPU scheduling, DMA and PS3 memory layout reproduced. Reference for this Studio's Killzone 2 recipe (WWS policy module) and runtime fixes; The Killzone Trilogy disc also contains Killzone 2.
tools.limits: Work in progress, partly playable (about 23 fps in its scripted test). Targets update 1.29 only. Commit 4771777 (2026-10-29) checked.

tools.name: Project Helghast (Killzone 3 PC port)
tools.purpose: Killzone 3 (PS3) static recompilation of PPU and Cell SPU code to Windows x64, built on your PC from your own disc dump (PS3_GAME folder or decrypted ISO), the 1.14 update and your decrypted EBOOT; installer builds in about 7 minutes. Boot, menus, all nine chapters load; XInput/SDL3 input; PS3-format saves. The Killzone Trilogy disc also contains Killzone 3.
tools.limits: Pre-release (v0.1.5), partly playable. Built for update 1.14 only. Commit f2bfeed (2026-10-28) checked.
